name: Ladder Filter
behavior: Four-pole low-pass ladder-inspired design; document algorithm/normalization/feedback/drive and what is approximated. Do not promise a named analog circuit match.
Internal cutoff clamp min(target,.45*sampleRate); shared5ms cutoff/resonance/drive ramps. Unpatched input0; reset zero internal state and snap targets.
Any nonlinear solve/oversampling has fixed declared iteration/work/memory bounds prepared outside rendering. No recursive unlimited convergence loop, allocation, locking or per-block randomization.
Choose a demonstrably stable resonance mapping over0..1; no self-oscillation claim unless implemented and tested. Do not silence instability via unconditional final clipping.
Provide derivation or pinned lawful source and notices. Advanced numerical review is mandatory before host acceptance.
acceptance: Impulse/step/DC and four-pole stopband response at resonance0; documented gain normalization.
Endpoint, high-drive/resonance and rapid-cutoff sweeps remain finite at every tested rate; bounded output and tails with justified thresholds.
Partition/state/reset/guards plus nonlinear distortion/aliasing limitations documented, not disguised as quality improvements.
